as_of_recipe: Load /why/{TICKER}.json for history_url and history_manifest_url. Use ONLY the COMPLETE history file whose build_id, SHA-256, byte count and object count match the manifest. Filter available_as_of <= D after normalizing timestamps to UTC; a date-only D means 23:59:59.999999 UTC. Do not substitute filing_date or generated. A capped PREVIEW returns INCOMPLETE unless returned equals total_available; it cannot establish zero historical evidence. D outside corpus_start/corpus_end returns OUT_OF_RANGE. Classification at D uses the label_history entry with the maximum eligible date, not list order. Before that ribbon, use yuclaw replay TICKER --date D on a research backend.

component_anatomy.formula: sum(weight * confidence * score) / sum(weight * confidence), excluding not_implemented components
component_anatomy.note: Confidence is a model input, not a calibrated probability. Current configuration weights do not establish historical weights. C4 is disclosed as frozen; no past score is changed.

descriptive_denominators_90d.note: Multiple events can come from one filing. Counts describe this corpus; neither events nor filings are independent observations by assumption.

evidence_objects_collection.note: PREVIEW: a capped newest-first slice; total_available counts objects in scope; an as-of query over this slice is INCOMPLETE unless returned == total_available
evidence_objects_collection.ordering: available_as_of DESC, accession_number DESC, source_hash DESC
evidence_objects_collection.scope: accepted evidence objects for XLP in the declared corpus

label: NEUTRAL
not_advice: Research and education only — not investment advice. Signal labels are research classifications, not buy/sell recommendations. Investment implication: none established — no buy, sell, or alpha conclusion is supported by this object.

conflicting_evidence.basis: Research-State Derivation v1 contradiction rule (CONFLICTED would surface here and in the research state itself)

dependency.basis: layered-dependency family registered (layered-evidence-dependency-spec, REGISTERED) — no name-scoped read yet

discovery_context.basis: Discovery Ledger v1 (results-blind name scan) + family adjudication state from Research-State Derivation v1

value.multiplicity: PENDING (Discovery Ledger family adjudication awaits registered read)

evidence_coverage.basis: Evidence Completeness Profile v1 counting rules; UNKNOWN and NOT_APPLICABLE are legal derived states, not gaps in this card

forward_maturity.basis: matured name-scoped primary endpoints in the Discovery Ledger at the build anchor

independent_evidence.basis: distinct observed evidence families (counting only; cross-family independence is declared, not measured — see dependency)

platform_component_context.basis: platform C6 risk-component reads recorded in the chain, rendered verbatim on the SCIENCE tab; the discovery family adjudicates at its registered read

research_state.basis: Research-State Derivation v1 precedence table over registered reads at the build anchor

sequential_evidence.basis: Anytime Evidence Record v1 — enrolled instruments are label-tier; the platform enrollment states render on the SCIENCE tab from the canonical artifact at build time
sequential_evidence.value: NOT_APPLICABLE at name level (enrolled instruments are label-tier)

truncation_impact.basis: the Truncation & Error Budget ledger is site-key-scoped; no registered per-name attribution exists — the full ledger renders on the SCIENCE tab, including PENDING counts

verify: source_hash identifies the original stored event record; it is not a digest of the displayed excerpt or the original SEC file. Public event inclusion verification: NOT_AVAILABLE. /evidence/verify.json describes SIGNAL snapshot ledger checks and does not authenticate this event hash. Quote occurrence, semantic support, arithmetic and external provenance are separate checks.
